        ### Question
        A 25-year-old man is brought to the emergency department 30 minutes after he was involved in a motorcycle collision. He was not wearing a helmet. Physical examination of this patient is most likely to show which of the following findings?

opb. Numbness of the left cheek
opc. Preserved left lateral gaze
opd. Absent left corneal reflex
ope. Complete loss of vision of the left eye

CHAIN: "Fracture of the greater wing of the left sphenoid bone" -> "Compression of the left superior orbital fissure" -> "Involvement of cranial nerves" -> "Preserved left lateral gaze due to CN VI not being affected" -> 70%
CHAIN: "Fracture of the greater wing of the left sphenoid bone" -> "Compression of the left superior orbital fissure" -> "Involvement of the optic nerve (CN II) possible" -> "Complete loss of vision of the left eye possible" -> "Unclear if optic nerve is affected" -> 60%
